description: This file defines an internal utility for asynchronous enumeration, including a generic class AsyncEnumerable<T> that manages publish-subscribe style updates and internal state and an associated asynchronous enumerator, supporting concurrent publishing, disposal, and iteration.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.AsyncEnumerator
classes.description: An asynchronous enumerator for iterating over elements of type T, supporting move next and dispose operations asynchronously.

methods.name: MoveNextAsync
methods.description: Advances the enumerator asynchronously to the next element.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes the enumerator asynchronously, cancelling any ongoing wait.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Element
classes.description: Represents an individual element in the AsyncEnumerable sequence, including mechanisms for validity, disposal, and linking to the next element.

methods.name: CreateInitial
methods.description: Creates the initial element with a special marker value.

methods.name: CreateDisposed
methods.description: Creates an element representing a disposed state with an associated exception.

methods.name: NextAsync
methods.description: Returns a task that asynchronously yields the next element.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next element in the sequence.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.TryPublish
methods.description: Attempts to publish a new element, returning a success status.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Publish
methods.description: Publishes a new element, throwing exception if invalid or disposed.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.TryPublish<TState>
methods.description: Attempt to publish an updated value using a provided update function.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Publish<TState>
methods.description: Publish an update using a provided update function, throwing on invalid or disposed state.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.GetAsyncEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous enumerator for iterating over the sequence.
